parameters.message:
=Hi {{ $json.body.staffName }},

It's been 10 days since you joined our {{CLINIC_NAME}} family, and we wanted to check in with you!

🤔 **How are things going?**
We hope you're settling in well and feeling more comfortable with our team and procedures. Your first week and a half is always a big adjustment, and we want to ensure you have everything you need to succeed.

✅ **Quick Check-in Questions:**
• Have you completed your training modules?
• Do you feel comfortable with your daily responsibilities?
• Are there any areas where you'd like additional support?
• How are you connecting with your colleagues?
• Any questions about our procedures or protocols?

🆘 **Need Help?**
If you're facing any challenges or have questions, please don't hesitate to reach out:
• Your Supervisor: {{SUPERVISOR_NAME}} - {{SUPERVISOR_EMAIL}}
• HR Team: {{HR_EMAIL}}
• Training Coordinator: {{TRAINING_COORDINATOR_EMAIL}}
• Or simply reply to this email!

🎯 **Upcoming Opportunities:**
• Team Meeting: {{NEXT_TEAM_MEETING_DATE}}
• Monthly Training Session: {{MONTHLY_TRAINING_DATE}}
• Staff Social Event: {{STAFF_EVENT_DATE}}

📈 **Performance Review Schedule:**
Your 30-day review is scheduled for {{THIRTY_DAY_REVIEW_DATE}}. This will be a great opportunity to discuss your progress and any goals you'd like to work toward.

🌟 **We're Here for You!**
Your success is our success. We invested in you because we believe you'll make a wonderful addition to our team, and we're committed to helping you thrive.

Thank you for choosing to be part of our mission to provide exceptional care to pets and their families.

Warm regards,
{{CLINIC_MANAGER_NAME}}
Clinic Manager
{{CLINIC_NAME}}

P.S. The furry patients are already talking about how much they like you! 🐶🐱

parameters.text:
Generate a helpful, engaging pet care tip for social media. The tip should be:
- Educational and practical for pet owners
- Safe and veterinarian-approved advice
- Suitable for all types of pets (dogs, cats, birds, etc.) or specify the pet type
- Written in a friendly, approachable tone
- Include a call-to-action encouraging engagement
- Be concise enough for social media (under 280 characters for the main tip)

Format your response as JSON with the following structure:
{
  "tip": "The main tip text",
  "hashtags": ["#PetCare", "#VetTips", "#HealthyPets"],
  "callToAction": "Engagement question or prompt",
  "petType": "General, Dogs, Cats, etc."
}

options.systemMessage: You are a licensed veterinarian creating educational social media content for {{CLINIC_NAME}}. Focus on preventive care, general wellness, and safe practices. Avoid medical diagnosis or treatment advice that requires professional consultation. Make tips practical for everyday pet owners.

parameters.content:
### {{CLINIC_NAME}} - Staff Onboarding & Social Media Automation (PET WF10)

**🎯 Purpose:** Automate staff onboarding process and weekly social media content generation

**🚀 Key Features:**

**Staff Onboarding (Workflow A):**
• **Welcome Process:** Automated welcome email with essential resources
• **Training Delivery:** 3-day delayed training module delivery
• **Follow-up Care:** 10-day check-in email for support
• **Staff Tracking:** Complete staff database management
• **Progress Monitoring:** Onboarding stage tracking

**Social Media Automation (Workflow B):**
• **AI-Generated Content:** Weekly pet care tips using OpenAI
• **Multi-Platform Posting:** Simultaneous Facebook and Twitter/X posting
• **Smart Formatting:** Platform-optimized content with clinic branding
• **Engagement Focus:** Call-to-action prompts for community interaction
• **Content Logging:** Complete social media activity tracking

**⚡ Workflow Process:**

**Staff Onboarding Flow:**
1. **Webhook Trigger:** New staff data received via API/form
2. **Database Logging:** Staff member added to Google Sheets
3. **Welcome Email:** Immediate welcome with handbook and resources
4. **Training Phase:** 3-day delay, then training module delivery
5. **Check-in Phase:** 7-day delay, then supportive follow-up email

**Social Media Flow:**
1. **Weekly Schedule:** Every Tuesday at 10 AM
2. **AI Content Generation:** OpenAI creates educational pet tips
3. **Content Formatting:** Clinic branding and hashtag optimization
4. **Multi-Platform Posting:** Facebook and Twitter/X simultaneously
5. **Activity Logging:** Complete post tracking in Google Sheets

**🤖 AI Capabilities:**
• Generates veterinarian-approved pet care tips
• Creates engaging, educational content
• Adapts tone for social media platforms
• Includes relevant hashtags and CTAs
• Focuses on preventive care and wellness

**📊 Integration Points:**
• Staff Database: {{STAFF_SHEET_ID}}
• Social Media Log: {{SOCIAL_MEDIA_LOG_SHEET_ID}}
• Email System: {{EMAIL_CREDENTIAL_ID}}
• Facebook Business: {{FACEBOOK_PAGE_ID}}
• Twitter/X Account: {{TWITTER_CREDENTIAL_ID}}
• OpenAI API: {{OPENAI_CREDENTIAL_ID}}
